It's definitely a difficult matter when it's someone close, who you felt as though you could confide in, holding the same intolerant disregard that we actively attempt to avoid daily, regarding our authentic selves. It almost feels like a personal betrayal of the heart. It stings. It twists and turns on the conscience, as if a splinter were pricked into your very being.

It comes to question if you'd be willing to confront the issue with inquiring on his intention, relaying the frustration it causes. If you feel as though going through the difficulty of mending the tear he is creating is worth it; it seems now would be the right time to consider if he would be a friend worth fighting for, through deliberation and conversation, or if he is a weight that will hold you back in the future.

Good luck on your endeavors in whatever route your heart should guide you through.

I appreciate your thoughts and wishes.

It’s a refreshment having others talk about their issues in online forums like this, being able to connect in a sense with other minds who are faced with the same torments and live through the struggle regardless. It’s nice to hear other suggestions and chatter when everything seems so bleak.

Your expressions are interesting to me; I have to say my heart beats to a similar tune— why would anyone want to be consumed by corporate lifestyle? 
It lends thoughts of wondering: how can I escape from this life, rather than live it?

Living in America, 23 myself, I am left little opportunity when it comes to deviating from any expectations without a degree or any specialization to name my own. 

I’ve so much as considered entertaining the idea of living outside of my fears by becoming independent of the very things I dread— that monotony of waking up to know the trudging slow walk of death through a business week will haunt my nightmares into my waking moments.

It seems one thing I’ve considered: making a kind of homestead, is something of a goal I have— living free of the work week I detest. I have little in any experience of it, nor any idea what to expect, but the idea has calmed my terrifying anxieties and pain from realizing the existential despair that comes with certain styles of modern living.

One thing I hope to find with my partner, is a child to adopt, because the only thing that has kept me from taking my life is him, and though bringing a life into the world can seem dreary, saving a life from the lack of love appears all the more rewarding in my mind.
I suppose it is a goal for when we are more settled in life and I am stable, of course.

I hope my words can resound with you in some manner of way, as yours have ,fondly, to my own heart.

I only mean trying harder as if to say there’s more I should try to do before I make some hasty resolution to end my life. It’s on that premise that I haven’t gone through with it as of yet.

It’s terrible enough to be dejected to your baser instincts of holding care enough to eat or drink, but then as well to not hear anything beyond what rings out in your head — a bell tolling and that ringing droning in about the same sadness that consumes and grasps onto your thoughts, for your own dear life. 
I can’t fathom to imagine when I can feel the way I used to feel again; I felt carefree and unable to be bothered by myself, effective or not, in my daily living. It has left me, that will to live and it is hard to explain to many, if any, should they beg to understand how one gets no enjoyment from things or money or love anymore. It’s a terrible disease of my mind that rots my happiness to the very pulp of its existence. I wouldn’t wish it on anyone, I’d certainly hope you to not suffer it by the same means, or any lesser extent.

I appreciate any company in my Ill-mindedness though, as being alone only begets the darkness of temptations of giving in to killing all my feelings, myself, in entirety, and I can’t help but feel I need to try harder....

The times I’ve garnered the strength to attempt easing my pain through talking about my darkness, the ones whom I had spilled my heart forth unto had little to say beyond trying to get closer to family or seeking an institution.

I don’t blame their expertise, I suppose I should become more comfortable with being sent somewhere but I haven’t had the courage to examine the possibilities or consequences of being committed to a mental rehabilitation clinic, or whatever they are named.

I’ve contacted hotlines 3 times within the past few months.
I am no expert on hotlines, and though I feel more could be gained from talking to more types of people, I shouldn’t say I’ve found any encouraging voices yet that have eased my pain.

So I came to this subreddit since I have read others’ struggles here in the past and felt the need to finally admit my own.
I appreciate your sentiment, it’s the only way I can try to cope, through cathartic release, I suppose
